title: Banks Act Guidance Note 1/2026 — Status of Previously Issued Guidance Notes
enablingLegislation: Section 6(5) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

subsections.text: All previously issued guidance notes are deemed to be withdrawn, terminated or replaced, except if such a guidance note is to remain effective and is then accordingly confirmed in Guidance Note 1 of that year. The guidance notes that remain effective will retain their original numbers and dates.
